title: Doctoral Programs at CEU (2027-2028 admission)
field: Social sciences, humanities, law, network and cognitive science
about: Central European University in Vienna accepts applications to its doctoral programmes, including Political Science, Philosophy, Sociology and Social Anthropology, Comparative History, Network Science and Cognitive Science, until 15 January 2027. Applicants by the deadline are automatically considered for the CEU Doctoral Scholarship.
requirements: Master's degree required for most programmes (Cognitive Science is the exception)

field "Social sciences ... cognitive science" -> objective "Human-AI collaboration: teaming, trust calibration, appropriate reliance on AI" (field-level fit; the stated requirements are degree and procedure rules)
